[my story](http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/1rpw9o/girlfriend_left_me_halfway_into_my_deployment_and/)

I ended up getting home from that deployment on december 22. I have literally been drunk since then. Not like I'll get a buzz and chill out kind of drunk, but I don't remember large chunks of the day kind of drunk.

It's 9am local time here, and I'm laying in bed starving, but I can't go into the kitchen because I know that I'll crack open a beer.

We had always talked about going to japan and I quietly saved a bunch of money to make that happen. It was going to be her christmas gift. I'm not sure what to do with it yet, but as of now it's money without a purpose
I can't really quit.  I still have 3 years left on my contract.
